declarations.name: AuiDialogRef
declarations.description: Handle of an overlay opened by `AuiDialogService` or `AuiDrawerService`.

declarations.name: AuiDialogService
declarations.description: Open components or templates in a modal AbsoluteUI Dialog.

methods.name: open
methods.signature: open<R = unknown, D = unknown>(content: Type<unknown> | TemplateRef<AuiOverlayTemplateContext<D, R>>, config: AuiDialogConfig<D>): AuiDialogRef<R>
methods.description: Open a component (it can inject `AUI_DIALOG_DATA` and `AuiDialogRef`) or a template in a modal dialog.

declarations.name: AuiDrawerService
declarations.description: Open components or templates in an AbsoluteUI Drawer.

methods.name: open
methods.signature: open<R = unknown, D = unknown>(content: Type<unknown> | TemplateRef<AuiOverlayTemplateContext<D, R>>, config: AuiDrawerConfig<D>): AuiDialogRef<R>
methods.description: Open a component (it can inject `AUI_DIALOG_DATA` and `AuiDialogRef`) or a template in a drawer.

types.name: AuiOverlayClosed
types.description: How an overlay opened by a service was closed.

types.name: AuiOverlayTemplateContext
types.description: Context of a template opened by a service: `let-data` and `let-ref="ref"`.

types.name: AuiDialogConfig
types.description: Options of `AuiDialogService.open`: title, description, `data` for the content, and the Dialog options.

types.name: AuiDrawerConfig
types.description: Options of `AuiDrawerService.open`: title, description, `data` for the content, and the Drawer options.
